Listening to music is considered a hobby which relieves stress among people. Music helps process feelings that cannot be expressed. While doing exercise in gym or out door activities, music blocks distractions and makes these activities faster. Music helps create unity through the shared play lists Music helps in cultural identity, basing on the type of music played. It reveals where one comes from for example amapiano and kadongo kamu. Music helps in celebrations which is crucial in bringing happiness among celebrants for example in parties Music is crucial in managing pain for example before surguries, music is played and patients feel less pain. Music is used in encouranging one another for example those who are depressed. Music is also used as sleep aid for example as lallabys for babies while going to sleep. Music is used as therapy among people for example those with autism, stroke which helps in recovery. Music is a vital mechanism in worship which helps revive spiritual life of many people all over the world. Music is used as a business tool for earning income through making money by publishing song. Music is also used as a political tool for searching votes.

How Work and Jobs have changed. The way people work today has greatly changed from the past as a result of technological inventions. Long time ago, most job plannings were focussed on fixed working hours and communication passed through memos and usually physical meetigs. The information and records were stored in files that filled the wall cabinets. Today, technology has done key tranformationns at the work place, with communications passed via emails, workers performing tasks virtually andmeetigs extensivelly organised through zoom and other video conferencing apps. Technology has also created new jobs like app development and many have got it very engaging than the traditional job styles that involved meeting at the office. These changes have brough flexible working schedules, helping parents and students at higher levels to balance studies and other social life aspects. This has been witnessed by Benard at BIP who is able to study and workk at the same time. technology also comes with several challenges such as the need for a constant internet connection which is also paid for leaving the poor behind. Automation has brought a great threat threat to the traditional workers who feel at risk of losing their jons. Conclusively, technology has made work more flexible through enhancing connectivity at all times. The key aspect is only adapting to the changes that it has brought for us.

Friendship is often descriped as one of the most important parts of life, and for a good reason. Humans are social by nature and the connections we build with ohter shape our happines, resilience and personal growth. A strong friendship provides more than just company; it offers a foundation of trust and support that helps as navigate both good and difficult times. Do, what makes a good friend? The most imprtant qualities are trust, royality, empathy and honesty. A good friend is someone you can confide in without fear of being judged. Trust create a sfae space where we can be ourselves. Royality means standing by someone even when curcumstances are challenging. For ibstance when i failed an important exam last year, my best friend David didnt just say its okay, he spent the evening making me a new study plan and checked on me for weeks after. That kind of support shows ture layality. Empathy is also cruical, good friends listen and try to undersatnd our feelings while honesty ensures the relationships stays genuine even when the truth is uncomfortable. Frinedship is important because it directly affects our mental and emotional well-being. in conclusion agood friend is trust worth, loyal impathatic and honest. freindship are vaital becuase they support our mental health and enrich our lives. While the nature of friendship changes whith age, its importance never fades.
